why: Two independent pieces of work, merged into one range. The grouping is not a judgement call: it is exactly the two commits this diff is made of. 30db0bb gave files with nothing to compare a single pane (layout, diffview, session, its test, and the docs hunk about diff panes); 2611f7e stopped caching an answer the caller cannot use (agent/init, cache, cluster, their tests, and the docs hunk about clustering). Their order relative to each other is arbitrary — they touch nothing in common — so that pair is marked unordered and excluded from the order figure, which then measures only what it can: whether dependencies inside a cohort are read in the right sequence.
